prompts:
Use case: identity-preserve. Edit the attached otter character model sheet using it as the exact reference. Redraw the FULL sheet in exactly the same landscape 1536x1024 composition, three horizontal rows, same spacing, 19 drawings: top row four turnarounds (front, 3/4, side, back), middle row eight head-only expressions (neutral, happy, excited, proud, sleepy, thinking, surprised, gently concerned), bottom row seven poses (waving, thumbs up, jumping with joy, sitting waiting, holding blank clipboard, stretching, reclining resting). Preserve the same otter identity, body proportions, warm rich brown body, light caramel paws, cream belly and muzzle, orange headband and single orange wristband. Full bodies and ears unclipped.
Make these specific refinements consistently throughout:
1. Add simple DARK-BROWN EYEBROW ARCS distinct from eyelids, placed just BELOW the orange headband, with enough clear space to read. Thinking (middle row sixth): one brow raised, other lower, pupils looking diagonally upward to the side, thoughtful closed mouth. Surprised (seventh): BOTH brows raised high, wide ROUND eyes and small O mouth. Gently concerned (eighth): brows slope UP toward the middle above the nose, soft worried eyes and subtle concerned closed mouth. These three must be unmistakably different. Give the other emotions appropriate clear brows too. Keep brows visible against cream facial mask.
2. Strengthen the CREAM FACIAL MASK to surround BOTH EYES AND MUZZLE as one broad contiguous clean-edged light cream shape against the brown head. Preserve the otter nose and broad muzzle. Make the small round ears slightly larger with simple rounded silhouettes. Prioritize otter recognition at 24 pixels: bold broad mask, rounded ears, broad otter muzzle. No fur strands or whiskers, no tiny details, not a bear or raccoon.
3. Correct bottom row sixth STRETCHING pose: torso leaning sideways, ONE arm extending STRAIGHT up OVER the head, elbow straight, clearly OUTSIDE and SEPARATE FROM the head silhouette with a visible strip of off-white negative space between arm and head. The hand must be above the head and must NOT rest on or touch the head. Other arm relaxed or at hip. Exactly ONE orange wristband on the same anatomical wrist as the reference, remove the extra wristband present in this pose. Keep feet planted.
Flat vector look, simple rounded primitive shapes, strictly uniform solid fills. NO textures, NO gradients, NO lighting effects, NO shadows, NO halos, NO background vignette. Background must be uniform solid warm OFF-WHITE, never brown or dark. Even grid, no text, no labels, no extra props beyond the existing clipboard. Do not change any other poses.

Edit the attached otter sheet with ONE targeted change: enlarge the CREAM FACE PATCH consistently on EVERY face, including full bodies and the eight expression heads.
Currently brown fur still surrounds the eyes. Replace that brown facial area with the SAME CREAM as the muzzle, forming ONE large connected cream mask extending from the muzzle UPWARD around BOTH eyes and behind the eyebrows, reaching almost to the lower edge of the orange headband. Eye whites and black pupils stay intact. The dark brown brows must now sit ON CREAM, below the band. The mask boundary is a smooth broad scalloped arch against the brown temples; outer sides of head and ears stay brown. This is a light cream whole-face mask with eyes embedded INSIDE it, NOT merely a muzzle patch and NOT thin eye rings. Both brows must be separate clear dark arcs.
Keep same character, same round enlarged ears, same warm brown body and light paws, same colors, orange headband and wristband, all 19 drawings and their scale, exact three-row layout, all poses including raised straight arm stretch, and uniform warm off-white background. Keep six of the expression heads as they are other than the new mask. In expression head six (thinking), one eyebrow higher than the other with the pupils looking up and to the right and a small thoughtful CLOSED mouth without a sad frown. Head seven surprised stays round-eyed O mouth with BOTH brows high; head eight concerned stays inner brows raised and soft closed frown. NO gradients or texture, use uniform flat fills. No text.

Precise localized edit. In this 1536x1024 sheet, change ONLY the SIXTH head from the left in the MIDDLE ROW, the head centered near x=1050 y=510 (thinking). Preserve every pixel outside this one head as closely as possible.
This head needs an unmistakable THOUGHTFUL, CURIOUS expression, not sadness or worry:
- Its LEFT eyebrow on the viewer's left is a short almost horizontal dark-brown arc positioned LOWER, close above the eye.
- Its RIGHT eyebrow on viewer's right is a clearly HIGH RAISED arch near the lower edge of the headband. Strong asymmetric brow heights.
- Move BOTH black pupils toward the UPPER RIGHT corners of their white eye shapes, so its gaze is clearly UP AND TO THE SIDE, not straight ahead.
- Replace the sad downturned mouth with a small horizontal closed mouth line, very slightly crooked, off-center. No frown and no O mouth.
Keep the cream whole-face mask, nose, round ears, orange headband, head outline and scale exactly unchanged. Do not add hands. The next head (surprised with round eyes and O mouth) and final head (gently concerned with inner brows tilted up and frown) must remain unchanged, so all three expressions contrast.
All other 18 drawings, colors, layout, blank ivory background, raised-arm stretching pose, no text: unchanged. Uniform flat fills, no textures or gradients.
note: Updated brows, cream mask, ears and stretch. Raster concept; 24px species recognition has not been validated with users.
